Intrinsically lower Crit Multipler (more forgiving due to reduced difference between bodyshot and precision damage).

Fires a massive overpenetrating laser that ricochets into five sub-lasers on impact with the environment, each dealing <pve 369 /> <pvp [145] /> damage. 

<link Bosses [#CombatantClassifications] /> take 95% decreased damage from sub-lasers.
